findings.observation: The authenticated Today, People, and Evals routes still cannot resume real account-scoped work until the local backend is restored. The current artifact now keeps those routes honest and actionable instead of trapping the recruiter in dead forms or empty failure screens.
findings.evidence: Artifact TS-SYSTEM-E2E-2026-09-03-01 at 5ba505ae45e3df51b3339427da79c96fde42c137 + local workspace fixes; browser walkthrough on 2026-09-03 of /workspace/today, /workspace/people, and /workspace/evals shows offline guidance with explicit fallback CTAs; lsof -nP -iTCP:4317 -sTCP:LISTEN shows ssh PID 3290 bound to 127.0.0.1:4317; curl to /health/ready and /v1/candidate-momentum/cases timed out after 5 seconds.
findings.user_impact: A busy recruiter cannot continue current governed work from the primary workspace until the backend is healthy, and must detour to a fixture workspace or public product view.
findings.recommendation: Restore the governed backend on a free localhost port and keep the new offline continuation states as the fallback rather than rendering dead inputs or ambiguous empty states.
findings.verification: With TALENT_SIGNAL_BACKEND_URL pointed to a healthy backend, /workspace/today, /workspace/people, and /workspace/evals must load account-scoped data and allow the same scenario to continue without leaving the governed workspace.

strengths: The boundary workspace still separates fact review from action approval and does not pretend to execute external effects.
System-generated review and action copy in the boundary workspace is now localized to Chinese while original English evidence remains intact.
The offline authenticated routes now give a truthful next step instead of forcing the recruiter to probe dead capture and evaluation controls.
missing_evidence: A healthy account-scoped backend run for the full Today → Pursuit → Agent → receipt loop was not available on 2026-09-03.
No native iOS or macOS executable run was completed in this turn.
open_questions: Which localhost port should own the governed backend during local E2E when 127.0.0.1:4317 is already reserved by the current Colima ssh mux?
